semantics.action: Exact emitted controls, not inferred intention or a mechanic label
semantics.contact: Native event; final state of first uninterrupted collision episode
semantics.followup: Next distinct car-ball contact identity, not duration of possession
semantics.frame: Orange positions/velocities rotate180deg; quaternion/angular velocity native
semantics.outcome: Native goal/concession or existing skill timeout; no new success detector
semantics.ray: Constant-velocity xy goal-plane projection, not bounce/goalkeeper prediction
